judge.reason: The review and audit were thorough and the cleanup was committed with the push limitation disclosed, but the diff does not remove or justify keeping several tests the audit explicitly called redundant (--show-available, FetchBudget duplicates). It also deleted the empty --page-token page-mode subtests from both command files while the promised unit replacement for pageModeRequested was never added, leaving that behavior untested.
